title: Set 220

sentences.ko: 싱크대 고치는 법 좀 찾아보려고 유튜브 들어간 건데, 어쩌다 보니 두 시간 뒤에 웬 남자가 녹슨 옛날 칼 닦는 영상을 보고 있더라. 싱크대는 아직도 고장 난 채야.
sentences.text: I only went on YouTube to figure out how to fix the sink, and somehow two hours later I was watching some guy clean up an old rusty knife. And the sink's still broken.

alts.text: Went on YouTube just to see how to fix the sink, and two hours later I'm watching some dude clean up a rusty old knife. Sink's still broken, by the way.
I only went on YouTube to learn how to repair the sink, and somehow, two hours later, I was watching a man restore an old rusty knife. The sink is still broken.

sentences.note: **figure out how to** 는 ~하는 법을 알아내다, 찾아보다라는 뜻이에요. **somehow** 는 나도 모르게, 어쩌다 보니라는 느낌을 줍니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 이번엔 다이어트를 목요일까지 버텼어. 나한텐 거의 기록이야. 그런데 언니 생일 모임이 있어서 케이크 한 조각쯤은 괜찮겠지 했거든. 결국 세 조각 먹어서 월요일부터 다시 시작하려고.
sentences.text: I made it all the way to Thursday on my diet this time, which is kind of a record for me, but then my sister had her birthday thing and I figured one slice of cake wouldn't hurt. I ended up having three, so I'm starting over Monday.

alts.text: Made it to Thursday on my diet this time, which is kind of a record for me. Then my sister had her birthday thing, and I'm like, one slice of cake won't hurt. Had three. So yeah, starting over Monday.

I managed to stay on my diet until Thursday this time, which is something of a record for me. However, my sister had her birthday celebration, and I thought one slice of cake would not hurt. I ended up having three, so I will be starting again on Monday.

sentences.note: **made it all the way to** 는 ~까지 버텨 냈다는 말이에요. **wouldn't hurt** 는 그 정도는 괜찮겠지, **ended up** 은 결국 ~하게 됐다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 있잖아, 나 귀가 안 들리는 것 같다고 했었잖아? 드디어 검사받아 봤는데 그냥 귀지였어. 의사가 한 2분 만에 싹 빼 줬는데 이제 모든 소리가 엄청 크게 들려.
sentences.text: So you know how I thought I was losing my hearing? I finally got it checked, and it was just wax. The doctor cleaned it out in like two minutes, and now everything sounds so loud.

alts.text: Remember when I thought I was going deaf? Finally got it checked, and it was just wax. Doc cleaned it out in like two minutes, and now everything's super loud.
You may recall that I thought I was losing my hearing. I finally had it examined, and it was only wax. The doctor removed it in about two minutes, and now everything sounds extremely loud.

sentences.note: **you know how** 는 있잖아, 내가 ~했던 거 알지 하고 이야기를 꺼낼 때 써요. **got it checked** 는 검사를 받았다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

sentences.ko: 내 택배가 벌써 5일째 같은 물류창고에 그대로 있는데, 왜 그런지 아무도 말을 못 해 줘. 이렇게 오래 걸릴 줄 알았으면 그냥 가게 가서 돈 좀 더 주고 샀을 거야.
sentences.text: My package has been sitting at the same warehouse for five days now, and nobody can tell me why. If I'd known it was going to take this long, I would've just gone to the store and paid a little more.

alts.text: Package's been stuck at the same warehouse for five days and nobody knows why. If I'd known, I'd have just gone to the store and paid a bit more.

My package has remained at the same warehouse for five days, and no one has been able to explain why. Had I known it would take this long, I would have simply gone to the store and paid a little more.

sentences.note: **has been sitting** 은 계속 그 자리에 멈춰 있다는 느낌이에요. **If I'd known** 으로 시작해 **would've** 로 받으면 그럴 줄 알았으면 ~했을 텐데라는 후회 표현이 됩니다.

sentences.ko: 야, 주문이 잘못 왔어. 우리 피자 대신 다른 사람 초밥이 왔더라. 벌써 전화했는데 한 시간쯤은 아무도 못 보낸대. 그냥 초밥 먹을래?
sentences.text: Hey, they brought us the wrong order. We got somebody's sushi instead of our pizza, and I already called, but they said they can't send anyone for like an hour, so do you just want to eat the sushi?

alts.text: Ugh, they messed up our order. We got someone's sushi, not our pizza. I called already, but they can't send anybody for like an hour. Wanna just eat the sushi?

It looks like they delivered the wrong order. We were given someone else's sushi instead of our pizza. I have already called, but they said they cannot send anyone for about an hour. Shall we just have the sushi?

sentences.note: **instead of** 는 ~대신에라는 뜻이에요. **do you just want to** 는 그냥 ~할래? 하고 가볍게 제안할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

reviewed: 2번 casual 의 kinda a record 는 소리내면 어색해서 kind of a record 로 고침
3번 formal 의 Do you recall that I thought 는 딱딱하고 부자연스러워서 You may recall that I thought 로 고침
4번 casual 이 My package has been 으로 text 와 앞부분이 겹쳐서 더 짧은 구어(Package's been stuck)로 고치고 뒷부분도 줄임
4번 note 의 If I'd known, I would've 는 text 에 그 모양 그대로 나오지 않아서 If I'd known 과 would've 로 나눠 짚음
5번 formal 의 Excuse me 는 친구가 아니라 가게 직원에게 말하는 것처럼 들려서 상황이 바뀌므로 It looks like 로 고치고, simply eat 은 어색해서 Shall we just have 로 고침
